verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a web-scraping and content-extraction tool, so site URL discovery (mapping) is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence documents only single-URL conversion (r.jina.ai) and web search, which can be restricted to a site with the site= filter. Neither is a documented way to list all URLs on a website; site-filtered search is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
